extraction.description: The screenshot shows the UiPath Agent Builder/Studio Web arguments panel with the Inputs section collapsed and the Outputs section expanded. Three output fields are visible: Conclusion, Justification, and Calculation, with Conclusion and Justification marked as required. The Outputs label and the code/schema view icon on the right are highlighted.
extraction.step_instructions: Click on the Outputs section to view or manage the agent output arguments. Click on the <> icon on the right side of the Outputs row to open the code/schema view for the outputs.
